notes: CAVEAT (brand-applicability scope, ships with caveat per program rule): the page states the styles found for Fedders-Airwell are being used here and that, although unconfirmed, it is believed all Fedders-Airwell units use these styles. That caveat goes to cross-brand applicability scope, not to the accuracy of the stated positions, so the text-verified style ships with this caveat on file. Parent: Fedders-Airwell (page fact). Only Style 2 ships. Styles 1, 3, 4, 5 are held (see style notes in report): Style 1 is held on SHAPE COLLISION with held Style 3 (both 2 letters + 9 digits + 1 letter), even though its week/year positions are text-stated; Styles 3, 4, 5 are held chart-only (month and year both live only in chart images). Held-style shapes recorded in report.md for the collision audit.

styles.era: Style 2: 2 digits, letter, 5 digits, year only
styles.notes: Source-page example 02J-60002 (normalizes to 02J60002): page 1-based year 1st-2nd characters, converted to 0-based half-open [0,2] -> '02' -> 2002 (1902 below the 1960 floor, 2002 valid). Month is the 3rd character (letter) per page text, but its letter-to-month mapping is chart-only in image FEDDERS-2-Serial-Number.jpg, so month is null and the style ships year-only. Pattern ^\d{2}[A-Z]\d{5}$ is disjoint from every held style's shape on this page (Style 1/3: ^[A-Z]{2}\d{9}[A-Z]$, Style 4: ^[A-Z]{3}\d{5}$, Style 5: ^\d{5}[A-Z]{2}$), so no shape collision. Second example is constructed (labeled here) and decodes under this file's own rules. Style numbering keeps the page's Style 2 id (style-2) so the gap audit traces to the page.
